name: l19_l20_visual_queries_v1
authoring: Queries authored from deterministic keyframe contact sheets, without reading anchor captions or retrieval results. English variants are frozen manual translations/paraphrases, not live Gemini output.
selection: 12 evenly spaced video IDs per group; alternating frame at 30% and 65%; every third video is development; remaining videos are held-out test.
relevance: Explicit visually inspected keyframe numbers in the source video. Unjudged corpus frames are not exhaustive negatives. Report known-target metrics rather than exhaustive relevance recall.
